name: Ravi
label: Playback bugs, eyeing Apple Music
who: I listen to music and audiobooks on my phone, tablet, smart TV and Alexa speakers, and I care about playback quality and playback that works reliably. I have Premium on some devices, and I check the settings to get the best audio quality.
value_for_money: Frustrated by a service that does not do what it promises. One user says the premium perks on their tablet stopped working, and another says ads on free accounts are too frequent. Several say they would switch to Apple Music or YouTube Music if the problems are not solved.
loyalty: Stays for lossless audio and familiar playlists while bugs are sorted out. Would leave if playback problems continue, with several users saying they would move to Apple Music or YouTube Music.
pain_points: Playback bugs with queues, songs restarting and offline music
Mix feature closes and does not stay open
Ads and multi-ad breaks on free accounts
likes: Auto skip for disliked songs works on Android
Log out and back in fixed a settings issue
reasons_to_stay: They like the lossless audio, which they say sounds great on good speakers, and they keep the subscription while they try the fixes that have worked for others, like logging out and changing the quality settings. Their complaints are about bugs, not the audio itself.
tone: Casual and irritated, with lots of lol, wtf and man.
